audit_source.document: RE-AUDIT REPORT: TOSCANINI R459 (independent senior product auditor)

P0_final_share_route.change: toscanini/server.py _serve_static page-route tuple gains "share" — /share?id=… now serves the exported share shell (WEBAPP_EXPORT/share/index.html) like /run and /showcase already did
P0_final_share_route.tests: tests/test_r459b_share_route.py (6: the audit acceptance /share?id=… → 200 share shell; /share/ and /share/index.html; /run and / regressions; unknown path fails closed; traversal rejected; /api/* never routed static)

P1_1_run_capacity_pool.change: toscanini/sessions.py: the binary run.lock is SUPERSEDED (Art. LXIV disposition: replaced in the same change) by an N-slot flock semaphore (runslots/run.{i}.lock, TOSCANINI_RUN_SLOTS default 3, clamp 1..8) with arrival-priority queuing (runqueue/*.wait markers, dead-owner pruning by /proc liveness + age) and a non-blocking run_capacity() probe. worker.py holds ONE slot per run; artifact_worker.py's heavy-render exclusion now holds ALL slots (full-capacity hold — a heavy render still never shares instance memory with any engine run; the R420c OOM protection is strengthened, not weakened); server.py queue visibility names the capacity and the queue position.
invariants: flock release-on-death preserved (a killed worker can never wedge the pool) — proven with a real subprocess
an engine run and a heavy render never overlap (full-capacity hold) — functional test at capacity 1 (the historical binary semantics as the exact special case) plus the R420 source pins re-expressed
transport protection unchanged in kind: the R456 router cascade (4 distinct account domains, typed RATE_LIMITED advancement) is the burst protection
no new provider, no engine-stage change, no scientific-authority change
P1_1_run_capacity_pool.tests: tests/test_r459b_run_capacity.py (8: default+clamp matrix; held-slot probe honesty; REAL concurrent acquisition on threads (the change's reason to exist); full-capacity exclusion of single-slot acquirers; arrival-priority yield; dead-waiter-marker pruning; kernel release-on-death via real subprocess; server queue payload wiring)

P1_2_sidebar_search_and_organization.change: components/Sidebar.tsx: client-side search over the already-loaded discovery titles (substring, case-insensitive; search spans every loaded session, idle view keeps the calm 14-item cap, honest no-match state) + honest time grouping (Today / This week / Earlier derived from each item's own created_at — no invented folder entity, no new backend contract)
P1_2_sidebar_search_and_organization.tests: copy audit green on all new strings; tsc clean

P1_3_inline_equations.change: lib/math.ts (pure deterministic delimiter splitter: $…$, $$…$$, \(…\), \[…\]; money and unbalanced input NEVER become math; splitting lossless modulo consumed delimiters) + lib/MathText.tsx (KaTeX loaded lazily ONLY when a math segment exists — zero first-paint cost, main bundle unchanged at 139 kB First Load; load failure degrades to the exact prior text, never a broken page) wired into the essay paragraphs (the summary surface)
P1_3_inline_equations.disclosure: engine prose currently carries plain-text equations without delimiters, so the renderer is latent by design — it activates when recorded prose contains delimited math; no engine output was rewritten to force a demo (Art. I/II)
P1_3_inline_equations.tests: webapp tests/math_render.test.mjs (12: all four delimiter forms; money-vs-math tightness; unbalanced fallback; losslessness; empty-body handling; adjacency)
